backend/main.mo: Motoko canister defining taxi pickup, customer, and reporting types with per-user storage maps and access‑controlled profile and data operations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping product requirements to affected frontend files, components, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of many frontend files describing UI behavior, styling changes, dialogs, and data‑flow fixes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file that mounts the React application and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top‑level React app handling authentication, backend actor initialization, and routing to login, profile setup, or main app.
frontend/src/components/AboutDialog.tsx: Simple modal dialog showing app information, copyright, and contact details.
frontend/src/components/ActorInitializat: Component that gates rendering on backend actor readiness, showing loading, connectivity diagnostics, or error recovery options.
frontend/src/components/CustomerLookup.t: Provides a searchable customer selector using a popover and suggestions API, allowing selecting or clearing a customer.
frontend/src/components/CycleBalanceDial: Shows the current cycle balance in a dialog with formatted display and a refresh action.
frontend/src/components/DailyReportDialo: Displays daily report data for a selected date range, including totals, summaries, and error/loading states.
frontend/src/components/DeleteAllRecords: Confirmation dialog that deletes all stored records using a mutation and shows success or error notifications.
frontend/src/components/DeleteDraftDataD: Empty or placeholder file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/EditDeleteRecord: Allows selecting recent pickups, editing their fields, or deleting them, with form state synced to the selected record.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileDialo: Dialog for viewing and updating driver profile information with validation and save actions.
frontend/src/components/ExportImportDial: Provides a dialog for exporting app data to a JSON file and importing normalized, validated JSON data back into the app.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders a simple footer with attribution and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/GeneratePDFDialo: Displays a dialog that generates and downloads a static HTML-based PDF specification document.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Implements the main header with theme switching, user menu, and shortcuts to various dialogs and account actions.
frontend/src/components/PickupForm.tsx: Provides a form for creating pickup records with validation, customer autofill, and pickup submission logic.
frontend/src/components/PickupList.tsx: Loads, sorts, and displays pickups for a selected date and computes daily totals including payment breakdown and driver owed amounts.
frontend/src/docs/manual-qa-android-chro: Checklist for verifying opacity, backdrop behavior, and scroll interactions of Radix UI overlays on Android Chrome.
frontend/src/docs/manual-qa-edit-delete-: Checklist validating scroll lock, dialog scrolling, transitions, and popover/select stacking in the Edit/Delete Record dialog on Android Chrome.
frontend/src/docs/manual-qa-version-103-: Regression checklist ensuring pickup creation, listing, editing, deletion, and daily reporting work correctly after version 103 fixes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor using react-query, refreshing dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorReady.ts: Wrapper hook exposing actor readiness state from useBackendActor.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.tsx: Empty placeholder file with no implementation.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendActor.tsx: Provider and hook managing backend actor creation with retries, health checks, identity changes, and readiness state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, loading, state tracking, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains React Query hooks for loading and mutating user profiles, pickups, and customer suggestions through the backend actor, with readiness and identity checks.
frontend/src/hooks/useRadixOverlayCleanu: React hook that removes stale Radix UI scroll‑lock styles on Android Chrome when no dialogs are open.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining light/dark OKLCH theme tokens, Android Chrome fallbacks, and Radix component styling fixes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point setting up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering the App component.
frontend/src/pages/AccountSetupPage.tsx: Page for creating or updating a user profile with validation, pulling existing data, and saving via mutations.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Empty placeholder file for the admin dashboard page.
frontend/src/pages/AdminLoginPage.tsx: Empty placeholder file for the admin login page.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login screen using Internet Identity with theme toggling and a styled welcome card.
frontend/src/pages/LoginSelectionPage.ts: Empty placeholder for selecting between different login options.
frontend/src/pages/MainApp.tsx: Main application layout showing header, footer, pickup form, and pickup list for a selected date.
frontend/src/utils/connectionDiagnostics: Utilities that normalize initialization errors and generate diagnostic messages based on network and health‑check status.
frontend/src/utils/errorMessage.ts: Utility that extracts stable, human-readable messages from diverse error object shapes.
frontend/src/utils/numberFormat.ts: Provides safe helpers to format numbers as currency or fixed decimals and to parse floats without throwing on invalid input.
frontend/src/utils/owedDriver.ts: Computes driver payout using a formula combining meter differences and credit/voucher tips.
frontend/src/utils/pickupGuards.ts: Converts between bigint nanosecond timestamps and Date objects, with safe fallbacks for invalid times.
frontend/src/utils/retryBackoff.ts: Implements async retry logic with configurable exponential backoff and jitter.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, animations, and container settings with several plugins.
project_state.json: Describes project state, goals, and known issues focused on fixing daily report display, scrolling, and summary accuracy.
